notificationBanner.guidance_link_text: Read our guidance about group claims.

consideringClaimsTogether.heading: Considering your claim with others
consideringClaimsTogether.description: A legal officer in your case has proposed to join your claim with others to make a group claim. You can find the reasons why, and details about the other claims in the letter.
consideringClaimsTogether.letter_link_text: View the Considering claims together letter.
consideringClaimsTogether.next_steps_part_1: You do not need to do anything. If you want to respond with reasons why you think these claims should not be considered together, or anything else, you must do this as soon as possible and by
consideringClaimsTogether.next_steps_part_2: at the latest. Other parties can also respond.
consideringClaimsTogether.objections_text: If there are no objections after 7 days, the tribunal will contact you again to say that the case has changed to a group claim.

partOfGroupClaim.heading: Your claim has changed to a group claim
partOfGroupClaim.description: The tribunal has ordered that your claim should be considered with others as it includes common or similar issues of fact and law.
partOfGroupClaim.next_steps: The case will progress as a group claim. The tribunal will contact you when the group claim is listed for a hearing.
